desc.zh: 豆腐几乎没有味道，长霉、加盐、放几个月却变得很鲜。松花蛋里没有微生物，为什么也走到了差不多的地方？七个可以拖动的模型：切链、两种酶、鲜味相乘、盐和水分活度、气味活度值、碱渗进蛋里、稀释后还剩什么味。
desc.en: Tofu has almost no taste, yet mould, salt and a few months make it rich and savoury. A century egg gets somewhere similar with no microbes at all. Seven models you can push: cutting protein chains, two kinds of enzyme, umami synergy, salt and water activity, odour activity values, alkali soaking into an egg, and what you still smell after dilution.

title.zh: 蛋白质切成氨基酸才有味道
title.en: Protein has to be cut into amino acids before you taste it

desc.zh: 随机切断肽键时，游离氨基酸的比例约为切开比例的平方；豆腐 0.24% 游离，腐乳约 6%–25%。还说明了腐乳、酱豆腐、红方、白方、青方的关系。
desc.en: With random bond cutting the free amino-acid share is about the square of the share of bonds cut; tofu is 0.24% free, fermented tofu about 6–25%. Also explains sufu, red, white and grey fermented tofu.

en: why does fermented tofu taste good

title.zh: 内切酶和外切酶的配合

desc.zh: 霉菌两天造出酶，酶在盐卤里切几个月；内切酶造出链头，外切酶才有地方剪，两种一起远快于各自之和。口感为什么变得像奶油。
desc.en: The mould makes the enzymes in two days; the enzymes work for months. Endopeptidases create chain ends for exopeptidases, so together they free far more than both alone. Why the texture turns creamy.

zh: 发酵为什么要放几个月

desc.zh: 鲜味来自谷氨酸，核苷酸让它成倍放大；用 Yamaguchi 等效鲜味浓度算腐乳烧肉。
desc.en: Umami comes from glutamate and is multiplied by nucleotides; Yamaguchi's equivalent umami concentration applied to fermented tofu braised with pork.

title.en: Salt, water activity and what can grow

desc.zh: Pitzer 模型算盐水的水分活度，对照各致病菌的最低生长值；盐越多越安全，酶也越慢。
desc.en: Water activity of brine from the Pitzer model against the minimum for each pathogen; more salt is safer but slows the enzymes.

en: why is fermented tofu so salty

title.zh: 气味活度值：闻到的不是最多的
title.en: Odour activity value: what you smell is not what is most abundant

desc.zh: 浓度除以阈值才决定闻到什么；腐乳的酯香从哪来。
desc.en: Concentration divided by threshold decides what you smell; where the fruity esters of fermented tofu come from.

en: why does fermented tofu smell good

title.en: Century egg: alkali soaking into an egg

desc.zh: 松花蛋不是发酵食品：氢氧化钠从壳外扩散进来，让蛋清凝成胶，碱多了又会化；颜色、松花和马尿谣言。
desc.en: Century egg is not fermented: sodium hydroxide diffuses in through the shell, gels the white, and liquefies it again if there is too much; the colours, the pine-flower crystals, and the horse-urine myth.

zh: 皮蛋蛋黄为什么是绿的
en: why is century egg yolk green

title.zh: 发酵食物是同一个原理吗
title.en: Do fermented foods work by the same principle?

desc.zh: 腐乳和松花蛋只有一半相同；酱油、奶酪、火腿、鱼露、纳豆、臭豆腐：谁来切、切什么、什么挡住坏菌。
desc.en: Fermented tofu and century egg are only half alike; soy sauce, cheese, ham, fish sauce, natto and stinky tofu: who cuts, what is cut, and what keeps spoilage out.

title.en: Why some people find it stinky

desc.zh: 冲淡以后剩下的气味组合不同；臭的分子还没有定论；对气味的喜欢是学来的。
desc.en: Dilution leaves different combinations of odours; the stinky molecules are not settled; liking a smell is learned.

zh: 臭豆腐为什么闻着臭吃着香
为什么有人喜欢吃臭的

title.zh: 钠、生物胺和铅：机制与标准
title.en: Sodium, biogenic amines and lead: mechanisms and standards

desc.zh: 腐乳的钠含量、青方的生物胺、皮蛋铅限量在 GB 2762 里的变化；只讲机制和标准。
desc.en: Sodium in fermented tofu, biogenic amines in grey sufu, and how the lead limit for century eggs changed in GB 2762; mechanisms and standards only.
